general.languageDesc: Menus, dialogs and messages. Parts of the app may still be English.
general.refresh: Refresh when the window gets focus
general.refreshDesc: Re-reads every repository's status when you come back to the app. Fetching from the remote stays manual.
general.reposDesc: Order, colour and badge are used across the Commit panel, the status bar and the push dialog.
repos.empty: No repositories in the workspace yet.
repos.confirm: Remove {name} from the workspace? Nothing on disk is deleted.
repos.problem.name: Give the repo a name.
repos.problem.path: Use an absolute path, for example /Users/you/Projects/app.
repos.problem.duplicatePath: That folder is already in the workspace.
patterns.problem.empty: Type a branch name or a pattern such as release/*.
patterns.problem.spaces: A branch pattern has no spaces.
appearance.accentDesc: Colours buttons, focus rings and selections. The logo keeps its own colours.
accent.adjusted: Shown as {color} so that text stays readable in both themes.
accent.invalid: Use a six-digit hex colour such as #2a9d8f.
accent.sampleText: Buttons, links, focus rings and selections follow the accent.
appearance.densityDesc: Compact makes rows and fields about two pixels shorter.
appearance.uiSizeDesc: The whole interface scales with it.
keyboard.intro: Every registered shortcut. Rebinding is not available yet. Bare Option chords are refused because they type characters on the Hungarian layout.
keyboard.conflicts: {count, plural, one {# conflicting shortcut} other {# conflicting shortcuts}}: the first one registered wins.
keyboard.conflictTip: Another shortcut uses the same keys
safety.protectionDesc: Read-only. These come from the engine and cannot be changed here.
safety.noMode: The engine does not report its mode yet, so nothing is claimed here.
safety.jail.off.label: Normal mode
safety.jail.off.detail: Commits and pushes work on your repositories. Live branches still need a typed confirmation.
safety.jail.readOnly.label: Read-only
safety.jail.readOnly.detail: INTELY_READONLY is set: every command that changes a repository or uses the network is refused.
safety.jail.e2e.label: Test jail
safety.jail.e2e.detail: INTELY_E2E is set: changes are only allowed inside the fixture folder, and only to local remotes.
safety.liveRowDesc: Type the exact branch name to confirm. Case matters, and --no-verify is refused. Agents can never fill this in.
safety.devDesc: The Run panel starts them, only when you click. Agents can never start a server.
safety.processesReadOnly: Read-only mode refuses every process. Switch this on to run dev servers for this session; the IDE's own git changes and network stay refused, and processes it starts get a git that only reads and a network-blocked environment. It is off again at the next launch.
safety.processesNormal: Only matters in read-only mode (INTELY_READONLY). In normal mode the Run panel always works; in the test jail only fixture folders are allowed.
safety.liveDesc: A push to a protected or live branch asks for a typed confirmation. The remote's default branch always counts as live.
safety.neverDesc: The commit guard keeps these out of every commit, even when ticked.
safety.naDesc: The engine does not list its guard patterns yet.
safety.secretsDesc: Untracked files over {mb} MB are guarded too. .env.example style templates are allowed.
safety.branchRulesFailed: Could not save the branch rules
aboutSection.doctorDesc: Checks the enabled providers: is the program there, is a key stored.
aboutSection.none: No provider is switched on, so there is nothing to check.
